t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the orange green red and blue gnomes lead you to a bright forest, gnomes come in pairs. the hat sizes are irrelevant. you want the most mushrooms,

vb_textbox.text: The goal of the game is to get the most amount of mushrooms. In order to do this, you need to focus on the multiply feature. If it is 5x you will need to choose the gnome that will take you to the forest with the most mushrooms. In my experience, it is all down to luck and the colours do not mean anything.
